That moment you walk into a pavilion and notice the raised committee room tells you who was meant to be visible and who wasn't. Aisha Malik

Subject: Nut-Free Snack Rota for U10 Team

Dear U10 Parents,

As we continue with our Sunday sessions from 09:30–10:45, we need your help in providing a nut-free snack for the team. This is a crucial aspect of ensuring the safety and well-being of all our players, especially those with severe allergies.

We require four families per week to bring in snacks. To make this manageable, we've created a snack rota. We're looking for volunteers to take a week at a time. If you're interested in bringing in snacks for a particular week, please reply to this email with the week you're available to help.

Your support in this matter is greatly appreciated, and we're confident that together, we can create a safe and enjoyable environment for all our players.

Thank you and we look forward to hearing from you.

Aisha

That gives the reader a clear hook before you rewind. Second, clarify the numbers and what they mean. You list the run rate and strike rates but don’t say why they mattered; contextualise the stats briefly — for example: "Sussex’s required run rate climbed from 6.2 to 9.4 in the last six overs, forcing them to up the risk and favour big hits."
